title: One month grid draws the public, team and suite calendars

source.ref: Plans and calendar clarity audit 2026-11-25 (project thread: Audit the project and calendar system; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/GUTHmChGkqaEmPSRUdzJHz)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-25: Daniel ruled 2026-10-28 to merge the three month grids once the suite landed. They are still three: components/events/event-calendar.tsx (1,828 lines), the settings StaffCalendar (1,110) and components/calendar-suite/suite-month.tsx (322). A fix to one grid (a day band, a chip, a time zone) misses the others. Fix: one components/calendar/month-grid module both remaining surfaces import; StaffCalendar removed (with SCAN-1344). CLOSED 2026-11-27: StaffCalendar was removed in #5526. The public Calendar tab (event-calendar.tsx) and the team calendar (suite-month.tsx) now both draw from components/calendar/month-grid.tsx: one set of weeks, one week start (lib/calendar/week-start.ts, Sunday, owner card open on 11-27 with Sunday recommended), one header order. The team calendar was Monday-first and the public grid Sunday-first, so the same date sat in different columns; the team week view, mini-month, Pencil it in and a Space website month follow the same start now.
